title: Triangle
identity: Pierre-Max Dubois’s Triangle is a three-movement work for one player and three saxophones with piano, published by Rideau Rouge as RR1217. The catalog lists Caprice, Lied, and Rondo; an academic appendix dates the piece to 1974 and gives a duration of 19 minutes.

evidence.claim: Catalog record provides one-player multi-saxophone title, publisher, number and movement labels.
IPCB thesis appendix lists Triangle (1974), one saxophonist with saxophone/piano instrumentation and 19-minute duration.
evidence.source_name: Polytechnic Institute of Castelo Branco thesis

review_focus: Inference: the one-player, three-saxophone setup makes instrument changes and coordination with piano central verification points.
collection_flag: Multi-instrument work for one player, three saxophones and piano; exact saxophone combination unverified.
gaps: Exact instruments, performance setup, and how one player covers the parts remain unknown.
proposed_corrections: Expand instrumentation beyond alto saxophone and piano to reflect the three saxophone parts, pending confirmation of which saxophones.
